plain: Every product is dual-licensed and public: copyleft, or a paid grant to ship closed. Hosted compression runs every pathway we own and keeps the smallest file that still restores. Signing keys, Chamber kernel secrets, and live customer data stay operator-only.
rule: Public source under dual license. Copyleft or a paid grant. Hosted compression uses every own pathway. Keys, kernel secrets, and AUTH_DIR stay operator-only.

dual.chooser: You pick copyleft or the commercial grant. Both are written.

copyleft_or_commercial.name: Slid Phi Labs public site and clients

never_on_this_surface: gzip, brotli, xz, or bzip2 sold as ours

fill.plain: Zeros demo. All-zero data → 8 bytes, and you get the original back. Free on POST /api/specialist. For real files, buy PCC.
fill.commercial: This demo is free. Everyday files use PCC.

struct_text.plain: pulsar is the free GPLv3 compressor (OSCB 55,745,438). STR1 is our structure transform on the PCC machine. $369/yr (SKU pulsar-exception) to embed pulsar in one closed product.
struct_text.commercial: GPLv3 in public for pulsar. Closed-source embed needs a written exception. STR1 rides the PCC year grant.

archive.plain: Hosted lossless compressor. $9/day · $37/mo (200 GB) · $369/yr (2 TB). Then 8¢/GB. First 2 GB/month free. Source is dual-licensed. PCC year is the closed-product grant. Official 12-file numbers live on /silesia.
archive.commercial: AGPL in public. Closed-product grant is PCC year. Keys stay operator-only.

general.plain: LBR1, own LZ wrap (LZW1), and LZMA-style LZM1 run on the hosted PCC machine. Dual license: AGPL-3.0-or-later, or a PCC year seat. LZM1 is a reimplementation, not host xz.
general.commercial: SKU gc-year. Hosted compression already uses this pathway.

paq.plain: Own mixers. PCAQ 256 KiB, ZMX1 1 MiB house, NNC1 256 KiB house. Not paq8px. Not cmix. Those stay GPL research opponents.
paq.commercial: SKU gc-year. Hosted jobs over the mixer caps skip them.
